text: どうも　ツイて　ないなあ　きばらし　でも　するか！

structure.jp: どうも　ツイて　ないなあ
structure.en: I just don't seem to be in luck...

structure.jp: きばらし　でも　するか！
structure.en: guess I'll do something to take my mind off it!

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state you are in; here it is the negative ていない with the い dropped in speech. ツイて　ない = 'I'm not in luck'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing offers it as one loose idea: 'or something'. きばらし　でも = 'something to take my mind off it, or whatever'.

patterns.name: 〜か (deciding)
patterns.explanation: か after a plain verb, said to yourself, means you are settling on what to do: 'guess I'll'. するか = 'guess I'll do it'.
